instruction: Set up VS Code to apply PEP 8 formatting to every code file in the workspace when opened, avoiding the use of external formatter extensions.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because VS Code does not have built-in code formatting capabilities for Python without extensions. Formatters like autopep8, black, or yapf require either extensions or external tool integration, which contradicts the no-extension requirement.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly classified as infeasible - VS Code lacks built-in Python formatting without extensions
